# Journal media test fixtures

These downloaded photographs are **synthetic test-account attachments only**. They are not shipped in the application or inserted into any user's journal. They provide representative detail and colors for responsive gallery screenshots; production content still comes from authenticated journal APIs.

Downloaded 2026-10-30 from Unsplash's public image service, unmodified:

- `forest.jpg`: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1441974231531-c6227db76b6e?w=480&q=75
- `sunrise.jpg`: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1470252649378-9c29740c9fa8?w=480&q=75
- `coffee.jpg`: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1447933601403-0c6688de566e?w=480&q=75

Audio is a generated two-second 220Hz WAV in `journal.spec.ts`. The video playback test records alternating flat colors from an offscreen canvas. Neither uses a real microphone, private media or external playback services.
